name: HWR_PUBLICATION_B
description: The publication table stores profile publication data.

columns.name: PUBLICATION_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the publication table.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: The Id of the source for this publication.

columns.name: AUTHORS
columns.description: The list of authors for this publication.

columns.name: PUBLICATION_DATE
columns.description: The publication date of this publication.

columns.name: TITLE
columns.description: The original title of this publication.

columns.name: PUBLICATION_TYPE
columns.description: The publication type of this publication.

columns.name: URL
columns.description: The URL for accessing this publication.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
